newsitem.title: USA: Paxson says to buy two television stations.
newsitem.headline: Paxson says to buy two television stations.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said Tuesday it has agreed to buy two television stations from subsidiaries of Fant Broadcasting Co.
The company was not immediately available to provide a purchase price on the deal.
Paxson said it will buy WAQF TV-51, in the Buffalo, N.Y. market, and KTVC TV-48, in the Cedar Rapids, Iowa market.
Paxson said these two markets will expand its nationwide broadcast television reach by 940,000 television households.
Paxson said each station will air its network of infomercials and other programming.
The company said the acquisitions are part of a plan to eventually extend its television distribution to reach 70 percent of the country.
